issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSongVerse visibility differs across artifacts. In the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md line 19) the method is specified as private; the provided template implementation (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 18) declares it private. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 33) declares the same method as protected. This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended encapsulation of the helper method (whether it should be accessible to subclasses or external tests) and may lead to incorrect implementations or surprising test behaviors.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the visibility of Farm.singFarmSongVerse across artifacts. Preferred action: change the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) to declare singFarmSongVerse as private to match the UML and template (i.e., private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). If the method is intentionally intended to be accessible to subclasses or tests, update the UML (problem_statement.md) and the template to indicate protected and document the reason. Ensure any tests that rely on the method's visibility are updated accordingly.
